THE STANDARD

Lily earns the work only if all six conditions hold.

  1. 01Repeated operational volume
  2. 02Company-specific judgment
  3. 03More than one system
  4. 04Permissioned action
  5. 05Exceptions and change
  6. 06Measurable outcome
One critical failure can deny the deployment.
